scientific_integrity: All full-domain conclusions supported by explicit polynomial inequalities and extremizers; finite symbolic checks are supplementary; the 2011 correlation-geometry full text remained inaccessible and priority risk remains.
scientific_limitations: Sharp only for infinite exchangeability, exact one- and two-coordinate success probabilities, and four trials with at least three successes; not a general moment-order hierarchy theorem.
title: Exact pair-moment bounds for three-of-four predictive success under infinite exchangeability
